source.title: Recueil des inscriptions en linéaire A. Supplément 1 (RILA-S1)
source.editorial_relation: The published description states that the supplement follows the rigorous and consistent methodology of Olivier and Godart's original Recueil/GORILA while newly editing texts discovered or completed after 1985 and published through 2023.

CNR_IRIS_record.warning: The currently described restricted attachment appears to be frontmatter/index only and must not be treated as the transcription-bearing RILA-S1 corpus without byte/content verification after lawful receipt.

official_author_contact.name: Maurizio Del Freo
official_author_contact.institution: CNR - Istituto di Scienze del Patrimonio Culturale

preferred_request_order.request: A lawful digital research copy of the transcription-bearing RILA-S1 volume, if the authors/publisher are able to provide one under appropriate research-use restrictions.

If a machine-readable source used to prepare the RILA-S1 transcriptions/sign index exists and can be shared for reproducibility, the original machine-readable files or an author-approved export preserving source notation and document identities.

If neither full digital copy nor machine-readable source can be shared, a fixed transcription-bearing sample selected independently of JANUS hypotheses, preferably a contiguous bibliographic/document range with at least 10 collision-free documents that can be identified before transcription-content inspection.

upon_receipt: Run the admitted generic source-intake quarantine before semantic inspection.
Preserve exact original bytes and calculate SHA-256/byte length.
Apply the frozen R3B-0 acquisition receipt machine contract.
Establish source/edition/licensing/provenance relation to GORILA/Younger/mwenge/SigLA without using candidate transcription content.
Build an identity-only source inventory with scientific transcription content excluded.
Execute the already-frozen R3B-1 overlap partition only after the receipt passes; do not redesign the partition after seeing content.

suggested_email.subject: Research request concerning RILA-S1 Linear A transcription data / digital research access
suggested_email.body:
Dear Dr Del Freo,

I am conducting a reproducibility-focused computational study of Linear A transcription corpora and would like to ask about research access to the transcription-bearing material of M. Del Freo & J. Zurbach, Recueil des inscriptions en linéaire A. Supplément 1 (RILA-S1), Études Crétoises 21.6 (2024), ISBN 978-2-86958-642-0.

I found the CNR IRIS record and its request-copy option, but the visible restricted attachment is described as frontmatter/index material. For the study I specifically need a source that contains the RILA-S1 document transcriptions and preserves the edition's document identifiers and source notation.

If permitted, I would be very grateful for one of the following, in order of preference: (1) a digital research copy of the transcription-bearing volume under any access/use restrictions you specify; (2) if machine-readable files were used to prepare the transcriptions or sign index and can be shared for research/reproducibility, the original files or an author-approved export; or (3), if neither is possible, a fixed transcription-bearing sample selected independently of my hypotheses, preferably a contiguous or pre-existing sample containing at least ten identifiable documents.

My protocol deliberately freezes document overlap and adapter-validation partitions before reading transcription content, and I will preserve the original bytes, provenance and any licensing/access restrictions. I am not asking you to select texts containing any particular sign group, word, or proposed linguistic match.

The purpose is to test cross-edition transcription robustness, not to claim a decipherment or to redistribute copyrighted material.

Thank you very much for your time and for the work on RILA-S1.

Best regards,
Oleksandr Ahapov / Hawkar
